A blocker has been open for more than 14 days.
An upstream program is forecast to finish after this program's target date.
Target has slipped more than 60 days from baseline.
A blocker has been open for 5 to 14 days.
Target has slipped 31 to 60 days from baseline.
Depends on a program that is Red.
Target date falls inside the team's change freeze.
Another source contradicts the reported status. Confirm with the owner.
No update in more than 14 days, so the status can't be verified.
No named owner or no target date.
